historical_commentary.text: The three-state checkbox form object introduced in 4D 2004 remains a supported form object property in current 4D versions, so the fundamental UI capability this note documents is still valid and usable today, whether in a binary Design Mode structure or a modern Project Mode form. The specific classic-language configuration steps shown are dated in presentation, but the underlying concept — a checkbox with an indeterminate 'mixed' state — is a standard UI pattern still relevant to form design.
related_updates: The three-state checkbox remains a form object option in current 4D form editors (Design Mode and Project Mode)
4D's form/object model has otherwise evolved considerably since 2004, including CSS-based styling and responsive form layout options
